chunks.title: Achari_mirch_fry
chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Today I am going to show you how to make Achari Mirch Fry If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel We have taken medium sized red chilli It is not spicy, it is slightly spicy We have washed it well and cut it in the middle First of all, we will add a little salt to it We will fry it We will make masala for it but it should be salty from inside So we will add a little salt to it Later also salt will be used in the masala For this we have taken some spices We have taken half spoon mustard seeds, one spoon cumin seeds, one spoon coriander seeds And half spoon carom seeds Half spoon black cardamom and one spoon sesame seeds It will give a very good taste We will roast all these spices We will roast all these spices on low flame We will keep it on low flame Till the time it doesn't get any aroma, we will roast it on low flame We will roast it We don't have to change its color much We have roasted these spices When it will get cool, we will grind it in the grinder Now see, for this we have taken some powder spices We have taken half spoon turmeric, two pinch asafoetida, black salt, white salt according to taste And this is Kashmiri red chili powder We will add it for color If you don't like it, you can skip it And one spoon dry mango powder We will add it for taste We have ground these spices And we will mix all these spices We have mixed all these spices well Now we will fry our chili first We will add some oil in the pan We will let the oil heat Then we will add our chili We will keep the flame on medium Now we will add chili We will fry it It is smelling so good It is very tasty We will flip it We will cover it for two minutes So that it will get fried well We will stir it We don't have to make it too much sauce It will be crunchy and a little sour Now we will flip it We will mix the masala that we have prepared in the same pan We have mixed it well Now we will add lemon juice So that it will taste better We will turn off the flame We will cover it for one minute So that all the spices get mixed well Here it is ready Achari meat fry If you like my recipe, then like it And subscribe to my channel You can eat it with roti, paratha or dal rice Thanks for watching
